title: The Beatitudes
reflectionQuestion: Jesus said God holds the gentle and the kind especially close. What is a kind or gentle thing you could do tomorrow?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Comfort & Bedtime, comfort-ritual, short-only). GENTLE SELECTIVE version per Adam (2026-06-20): comfort, not theology class. Includes the kid-reachable blessings -- the sad/comforted, the gentle, the merciful, the pure in heart, the peacemakers -- plus 'poor in spirit' rendered as 'those who know they need God.' DELIBERATELY OMITS 'persecuted for righteousness' (too heavy for 4-7). Same softening doctrine as the Cross (held not sad), Esther (courage not danger), etc. Comfort-ritual = WEB-faithful but child-rendered (a paraphrase frame, not a verbatim recitation, because the literal Beatitudes are abstract here -- unlike Psalm 23 / Lord's Prayer which recite whole). Gentle frame (Jesus on the hillside) + soft bedtime close ('rest now, little one... you are blessed'). 'blessed' explained as loved/cared for/safe with God. VOICE_ARABELLA (tender nurturer; also narrates Psalm 23 -- consistent comfort-ritual voice).
